title: The Pilate Stone

images.caption: The limestone block with Pilate’s name in Latin.

facts: 1961, in the Roman theatre at Caesarea Maritima, reused as a step
Italian team led by Antonio Frova
The Israel Museum, Jerusalem; a replica stands at Caesarea
p: A limestone block from a building Pontius Pilate dedicated to the emperor Tiberius. The damaged Latin text reads, in part, […]S TIBERIEUM / [PON]TIUS PILATUS / [PRAEF]ECTUS IUDA[EA]E: “Pontius Pilate, prefect of Judea.”

It is the only inscription from his lifetime that names Pilate, and it gives his title as prefect, the rank Roman governors of Judea held before AD 41. Caesarea was the governor’s seat; he came up to Jerusalem at the festivals, as the Gospels show him doing at Passover.
